verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser runs a dedicated startups and entrepreneurs practice and says its attorneys wrote 'Immigration for Startups: A Guide for Founders'. Its practice page acknowledges that founders must adapt visas built for employment to self-employment, which is the core of self-petitioning through one's own company. The pack, however, has no documentation of the specific mechanics the story asks for. Missing for 10: documented beneficial-ownership rules, board/employer-employee control arrangements for founder petitions, coverage of the 2023+ USCIS founder/entrepreneur guidance, and any independent corroboration.
